title: Spring Eggstravaganza

facts.statement: The Free Realms Wiki invited players to write about the recently held Spring Eggstravaganza event, as part of its 'Wiki Wednesday' feature.
facts.quote: What do you know about the Spring Eggstravaganza ? The Free Realms Wiki has room for lots of info about this recent event

article_summaries.title: Wiki Wednesday: Spring Eggstravaganza
article_summaries.summary: A short official News page (captured 2013-04-11, shown as posted '1 week, 16 hours ago') inviting players to contribute to the Free Realms Wiki article on the Spring Eggstravaganza, described as a recent event. It gives no event details itself; the client text table supplies the event's mechanics (eggs hidden in Sacred Grove from the 28th through the 31st, cracked open on Spring Eggstravaganza day).
